ext.graph_deploy.submit.purpose: Register one rollout of a builder-approved merged aq-graph revision in the opted-in disposable environment.

input.revision: Full merged aq-graph Git commit SHA.
input.expected_generation: Last observed desired generation, or zero for an empty environment.

outcomes.refused: The project, revision, provenance or generation did not qualify.

ext.graph_deploy.observe.purpose: Read reconciliation evidence for a previously registered generation.

outcomes.queued: Intent is durable and awaits controller dispatch.
outcomes.running: Controller work is in progress or health needs a fresh observation.
outcomes.healthy: Docker reports the verified image config running with a healthy Graph readiness check.
outcomes.failed: Staging or reconciliation failed with a diagnostic.
outcomes.superseded: A newer desired generation fences this operation.
outcomes.refused: The project or deployment generation is unavailable.
